summary:
Independent design Review of the complete current frozen Task56 specification 2cefeedd6fb99f26b0e7562ff4fc57f5b1beadab0b397802455b04af14f673a1, current design context c1bbd71cb08c832bf9c21844f85cf897018cb91740d7ffb0a4a01c56fc930d38, amendment005, preserved 3a782 specification, original integration600 prerequisite failure and actual isolated 3.11/3.13/3.14 input facts. No blocking design finding. This actual independent worker has not authored Task56 production, tests or fixture implementation and remains the same real worker for independent Review and verification.

The additional production scope is exclusively external_review._metadata_identity Windows fifth-component creation-time selection. A present st_birthtime_ns is used, including a valid integer zero; only attribute absence falls back to legacy st_ctime_ns. POSIX retains st_ctime_ns even where birthtime is available. Do not use truthiness, float timestamp conversion or broad exception suppression. The first four fields, all path/handle comparisons, both current bounded reads, raw-byte equality, size/growth/replacement refusal, lexical and reparse checks and current safe error behavior remain. Git transport, import interfaces or transactions, Schema, Policy, command selectors, MINENV and deadlines are excluded. The latest amendment explicitly and narrowly supersedes the old report-identity exclusions without rewriting their preserved history.

The additional tests and operating documentation are a distinct task-free safety maintenance unit under active maintenance mode, with separate commits as stated by rule8; Task56 owns governance production and retains their cumulative validation impact. Scope is exactly the prior twenty-one paths plus external_review.py, test_external_review_metadata.py and external-review-import.md. No approval types are merged or reduced by this ownership arrangement.

Acceptance requires Windows present/zero/attribute-absence creation-field cases, POSIX ctime preservation, changes in every retained identity component, unchanged atomic-published real input, and refusal of equal-size or equal-byte replacement with restored mtime, growth and read-between mutation. Existing first/second-handle replacement, growth, exact-limit and raw-double-read assertions remain. The local metadata module must execute independently on the exact locked 3.11.9, 3.13.15 and 3.14.7 runtimes. Cross-runtime device-number differences are not mistaken for within-runtime file drift.

Actual preserved probes show that the same ordinary 127-character, 1305-byte file has unchanged raw SHA. In 3.11 its path/handle five-field identities agree; 3.13 and the prior 3.14 show path ctime 1790763800488195400 versus handle ctime 1790763800490192800 while creation time agrees. This explains the current rejection of this exact legitimate input only, not all failures or the integration timeout cause. The 3.13 isolated install, locked dependency preparation, import and stdlib probes exited zero; they are not application/test PASS. Only authorized ignored SOURCES.txt changed, source and shared runtime/ref bindings did not, and independent vendor archive checksum verification remains unknown.

The exact 3.13.15 runtime may be chosen for a fresh formal default V2 only after the current fixed repair candidate's complete original external-review module and original integration600 both actually pass in that runtime with the original environment, owned leaf, selectors and deadlines. Failed comparisons remain preserved; no partial output, single case, profiler timing or earlier evidence substitutes for a complete result. Fresh preflight must bind actual runtime/import/locked dependencies, current source/spec/Policy and a new approved single-use action. No consumed action is reused. All fourteen native checks, five fixed mutations, 85 percent total and 90 percent diff coverage, static/whitespace gates, independent implementation Review, native finalization, current code approval and Gate remain mandatory. CI stays Python 3.11 with unchanged required checks. No performance, implementation, runtime comparison, full V2, task completion or publication success is asserted.

The cumulative temporary-root ownership, original fixture physical-I/O and owned Git ten-second cleanup, bounded pure YAML decoding isolation, fresh reads/live validations, pristine session-private fixture eligibility and independent Git-copy boundaries remain fully part of the design and future implementation Review. Task55 must use only a truly gated dependency and still obtain its own transport admission; no publication, provider or later phase is started by this design Review.
